description: This dataset compiles human-observed occurrences of the plant species Pectocarya recurvata, primarily sourced from iNaturalist. The records are concentrated in the southwestern United States, specifically across Arizona, California, Nevada, and New Mexico, with observation dates ranging from 2014 to 2026. Each entry includes precise taxonomic classification, geographic coordinates, and temporal data, alongside attribution to the observers and rights holders. While elevation data is largely missing, the dataset provides valuable spatial and temporal distribution insights for this species. Researchers can utilize these records for ecological modeling, biodiversity monitoring, and studying the phenology of Pectocarya recurvata across its native range.
